items.text: Even games where death is a common occurrence can be fun.  This one is not.  Tried to do Gigs, nope can not complete.  Tried to salvage.  Nope you died of air or your ship has exploded without discernible cause.  Tried to fix up the ship and got it all repaired.  Nope a cop rammed your ship trying to board it and destroyed it.  Despite several attempts I could not find any fun in this game.  The concept seems like it would be fun but the constant unexplained failure keep it from every becoming realized.
items.text_zh: 即使是死亡司空见惯的游戏也可以很有趣。这个不是。试着做任务，不行，完不成。试着打捞。不行，你死于空气，或者你的飞船毫无明显原因地爆炸了。试着修飞船，把它全修好了。不行，一个警察撞了你的飞船试图登船，把它毁了。尽管尝试了好几次，我在这款游戏里找不到任何乐趣。这个概念看起来会很有趣，但持续不断且无法解释的失败让它永远无法成为现实。

observations.evidence: Tried to do Gigs, nope can not complete.
observations.evidence_zh: 试着做零工，不行，无法完成。
